json.question_restated: Why was taxi demand on Saturday 2024-07-27 (66,660 trips) so much lower than on Wednesday 2024-07-31 (109,582 trips)?
json.baseline: Compare hourly trip rates (trips/hour) to normalize for the 13h vs 24h coverage gap; also compare Saturday 2024-07-27 to other July 2024 Saturdays for day-of-week context

hypotheses.claim: The apparent demand drop is primarily a data coverage artifact: Saturday 2024-07-27 only has 13 hours of trip data (11:57–23:59) vs 24 hours for Wednesday 2024-07-31, missing the early-morning hours entirely.
hypotheses.test: SELECT pickup_date, COUNT(*) AS trips, COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_hour) AS hours_covered, ROUND(COUNT(*)/COUNT(DISTINCT pickup_hour),1) AS trips_per_hour FROM investigator.trips WHERE pickup_date IN ('2024-07-27','2024-07-31') AND is_valid_trip GROUP BY pickup_date

hypotheses.claim: Even after hourly normalization, Saturdays in July 2024 have intrinsically lower demand than Wednesdays due to day-of-week patterns (e.g., fewer commuters, different leisure timing).
hypotheses.test: SELECT pickup_dow, ROUND(AVG(hourly_trips),1) AS avg_trips_per_hour FROM (SELECT pickup_date, pickup_dow, pickup_hour, COUNT(*) AS hourly_trips FROM investigator.trips WHERE pickup_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-07-31' AND is_valid_trip GROUP BY pickup_date, pickup_dow, pickup_hour) t GROUP BY pickup_dow ORDER BY pickup_dow

hypotheses.claim: Weather on 2024-07-27 (e.g., heavy rain or extreme heat) suppressed taxi demand relative to 2024-07-31.
hypotheses.test: SELECT w.day, w.temp_max_c, w.precip_mm, w.wmo_code, COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trips FROM investigator.nyc_daily_weather w LEFT JOIN investigator.trips t ON t.pickup_date = w.day AND t.is_valid_trip WHERE w.day IN ('2024-07-27','2024-07-31') GROUP BY w.day, w.temp_max_c, w.precip_mm, w.wmo_code

hypotheses.claim: Airport-related trips (which are high-volume) were unusually low on 2024-07-27 vs 2024-07-31, driving the overall gap.
hypotheses.test: SELECT pickup_date, SUM(CASE WHEN pickup_zone IN ('JFK Airport','LaGuardia Airport','Newark Airport') OR dropoff_zone IN ('JFK Airport','LaGuardia Airport','Newark Airport') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS airport_trips, COUNT(*) AS total_trips FROM investigator.trips WHERE pickup_date IN ('2024-07-27','2024-07-31') AND is_valid_trip GROUP BY pickup_date
